## Powers
In Round 1, take [Leaf on the Wind](item_b64de259-d122-407d-a7e4-9d7267310704). [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) is also an option, but [Leaf on the Wind](item_b64de259-d122-407d-a7e4-9d7267310704) will result in higher Stadium Cash gains, which tends to snowball as a game goes on. Picking it in Round 1 also allows you to give yourself the [Move Speed](stat_move_speed) buff from [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) in Round 2, because the bouncing Ofuda can target Kiriko herself.

## Items
For maximum offensive power (and Stadium Cash income), take [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), and [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318).

For maximum tankiness, take [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) and [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6).

You can also mix and match.

It is rare that you cannot play around the enemy's hero and build choices well enough to make the offensive items better, but use your best judgement. Item choices in Round 1 are relatively unimportant.

By Round 2, you should have enough Stadium Cash to buy [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) and [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e). For an Ofuda build, these two Items offer the biggest bang for your buck in the Rare category.
[Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) in particular is so good that it will likely stay in your build until Round 7, and maybe through the rest of the game.

If you have enough Stadium Cash, [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) is usually an upgrade to [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e). You can also swap [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) for [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) if you're dealing damage consistently enough but find your Ofuda to be reaching allies too slowly.

Use your remaining Stadium Cash to purchase Rare and/or Common Items to fill the remaining slots, keeping in mind that a generic Rare Item is usually worth just slightly more than two Common Items, but costs more than three times as much as one. Thus, three Common Items is usually better than one Rare Item.

## Powers
Since you already have [Leaf on the Wind](item_b64de259-d122-407d-a7e4-9d7267310704) from Round 1, [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) will now get maximum value.
If for some reason you took [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) in Round 1, take [Leaf on the Wind](item_b64de259-d122-407d-a7e4-9d7267310704) now.

## Items
You should now have enough Stadium Cash for [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) and [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124), along with at least one more Rare and a few Common Items. Fill the rest of the Item slots as appropriate, using the same Rare and Common Items recommended in the previous rounds.

The same plan applies as in Round 3. Pick up the best possible combination of Items that increase [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) and benefit Healing Ofuda.

In an ideal scenario, you'll have enough Stadium Cash to obtain [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) while keeping [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) and [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124). Fill the remaining slots with the best Items you can, following the recommendations from previous rounds.

If you find yourself needing some extra tankiness in this round, take [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) instead of [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48).

## Powers
Round 5! This is where you become a real tank, using [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663). With this Power, both you and whoever you are pocketing will be incredibly hard to kill. You'll essentially be playing to out-sustain the opposing team, drawing battles out until they run out of resources. Note that because [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663) heals you based on your Max Life and because the healing from [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663) actually generates Ultimate Charge, you'll want to take some Items that give you more HP, Armor, or Shields to maximize that healing. We'll get to that in the Items section.

However, if you haven't struggled to stay alive at all up to this point and you don't think you'll need the self-sustain from [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663), you can take [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) instead. Even without a dedicated build around it, the explosive Kunai can do serious damage, especially if the enemy team isn't expecting it. Best of all, you don't have to make any playstyle changes to get immediate value from this item - simply play on an angle at range with a pocket and weave Kunai and Ofuda as you've been doing already. If you make it to Round 7 later, you'll be able to lean even further into the offensive value of this Power.

## Items
Start by selling all of your Items except [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) and [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124). You will buy back any other items at the end with your remaining Stadium Cash.

- If you chose [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663):
Buy [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) and [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d). These two items ***must*** go together - neither one will cut it individually. With these two items and [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663), you'll be nigh-unkillable in a balanced fight, as long as you have someone nearby to throw Ofuda at.

- If you chose [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657):
You chose this Power because you wanted more offensive pressure, but you're likely still going to need some durability. Fortunately, there's an Item that combines both: [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643). The combination of [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power), [Weapon Lifesteal](stat_weapon_lifesteal), and the Overhealth effect should be just enough to keep you alive, especially with the increased damage from explosive Kunai.

Finally, buy Weapon Items as recommended in previous rounds with your remaining Stadium Cash. If you can afford it, the best Epic option is [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48), followed by [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40). The best Rare options (in order) are [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e), [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242), and [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054).

The item recommendations chosen for display are roughly what an average Round 5 build with [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663) should look like.

Round 6 is more of the same, regardless of which Power you took in Round 5. Since your Survival Items are already set, keep picking up new Weapon Items, optimizing for overall [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed).

An example "average" build for this stage is displayed, but don't feel like you have to match it perfectly. As long as you have the critical Items to match your Power choices, you're good.

A list of good Weapon Items is provided in the "Optional Items" section. Mix and match those until you have a good combo.

## Powers
In Round 7, your Power choice is mostly free, but some choices stand out over others.
- In particular, if you chose [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) in Round 5, [Keen Kunai](item_d5993121-8a5f-4c59-9145-19dc55265f48) is a great choice in Round 7, to further lean into the strength of the explosive Kunai. Because a Kunai crit replenishes 3 ammo, it's possible to get far more than 3 explosive Kunai from a single reload if you hit enough crits. However, other Powers can still be good, or even better. Read on.
- Regardless of your Round 5 Power, It's hard to go wrong with [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b). Even without any [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) or [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), simply having two charges of Suzu can be incredibly handy, and can help you swing fights that might be otherwise unwinnable.
- One high-risk, high-reward Power I quite like is [Spirit Veil](item_1772ce7d-37ed-41e4-8bac-d9b260aa59ad). To get maximum value from it, you need to find a way to get into the middle of or behind the enemy team without dying when you have Kitsune Rush, and then make the most out of the chaos you create with those 4 seconds of invulnerability. It's particularly effective as a Round 7 Power because it will always catch the enemy off guard, making you much more likely to win crucial teamfights that secure the round.

## Items
Items for Round 7 are pretty straightforward, and still depend mostly on your Round 5 Power.
- If you went for [Self-Care](item_0b7b0332-9bf6-4905-810e-7614b914d663) in Round 5, your final build should be [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8), [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d), [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f), [Amari's Antidote](item_67e0b1c5-3bcb-4ab5-b818-5082e5706124), [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48), and [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40). This is the displayed build recommendation. If you don't have enough Stadium Cash, you can substitute [Farsight Focus Sash](item_103e6d35-a71f-48c7-b7b9-b89efae62242) or [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) for [Spirits’ Guidance](item_25513335-271e-402b-bd03-9d082a281c40).
- If you went for [Foxy Fireworks](item_d29ac7bb-d84c-44d7-8944-24c9b668b657) in Round 5, your Item core should be [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) and [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48), with the other Items focusing on a mix of your choice between Healing Ofuda utility and Kunai lethality. The best options for Healing Ofuda utility are displayed in the recommended build, and the best options for stronger Kunai damage are displayed in the "Optional Items" section.
